[Verse 1]
[G7]People say that
[C#dim/G]you're no good, But
[Cm/G]I wouldn't cut you loose, baby, if I
[G]could. I
[G7]seem to stay down
[C#dim/G]on the ground,
[Cm/G]Baby I'm too far gone to turn aro-
[G]und. Oh if
[G7]only you would make up
[C#dim/G]your mind,
[Cm/G]Take me where you go, you're
[G]leaving me behind.

[F/C]come and [C]go blues,
[G5]
yes you do

[F/C]come and [C]go blues,
[G5]

[G][C/G]like a fool.

[C#dim/G]
[Cm/G]
[G]Just like a fool
[G7]
[C#dim/G]
[Cm/G]
[G]

[Verse 2]
[G7]'Round 'n' 'round,
[C#dim/G]'round we go Don't
[Cm/G]ask me why I stay here, I don't know.
[G]
[G7]Maybe I'm a
[C#dim/G]fool to care,
[Cm/G]Without your sweet love, I would
[G]be nowhere. So
[G7]here I stay, locked
[C#dim/G]in your web,
[Cm/G]Till that day I
[G]might find someone else.

[Bridge]
[G]I don't
[G7sus2]know,
[F/C][C]just when that would
[G5]be,
[G]I don't
[G7sus2]know,

[Verse 3]
[G7]Sail on, darlin',
[C#dim/G]sail on
[Cm/G]You just go your way, and I'll go mine
[G]But
[G7]it seems to me, that
[C#dim/G]I once heard
[Cm/G]That everything is finally cured by time
[G]Darlin',
[G7]sail on, Baby',
[C#dim/G]sail on
[Cm/G]I'll just wish you good luck And I'll
[G]see you when you come next time.
